title: Lacuna · memory that knows what changed
description: A temporal, provenance-first memory layer for agents, built on HydraDB. Every claim keeps the sentence it came from, corrections leave the old value queryable, and when the evidence does not support an answer it abstains with a reason instead of guessing.

sections.heading: Keep the old fact without letting it win.
sections.text: 02 · HISTORY Keep the old fact without letting it win. Supersession is explicit. A correction changes the current answer while the earlier claim stays available for audits, timelines and handoffs. INSPECT THE TIMELINE ↗

sections.heading: Refuse to invent consensus.
sections.text: 03 · CONFLICT Refuse to invent consensus. The billing-gate record names two runbook owners and neither source resolves the other. Lacuna preserves both claims and returns no answer. INSPECT THE CONFLICT ↗

sections.heading: Move through the field. Verify in rows.
sections.text: 04 · GRAPH + TABLE Move through the field. Verify in rows. HydraDB holds the temporal evidence graph. The overview is for navigation; the proof path shows exact edges; the table makes every visible record readable. EXPLORE THE GRAPH ↗

sections.heading: Connect the tools you already use.
sections.text: 05 · CLIENTS Connect the tools you already use. Claude, ChatGPT read and fetch, Codex, local runtimes and custom clients can address the same workspace through MCP, the CLI or the HTTP API. CONNECT MCP ↗

sections.heading: Turn memory into governed work.
sections.text: 06 · AGENTS Turn memory into governed work. Researcher and Reviewer presets start with a bounded Context Pack. Runs retain their lifecycle, tools, artifacts and final state; schedules retain their next eligible time. OPEN AGENT RUNTIME ↗

sections.heading: Talk to the same evidence path.
sections.text: 07 · VOICE Talk to the same evidence path. The governed voice route exposes listening, transcription, thinking, speaking, interruption and failure as explicit states. When speech is unavailable, the typed path remains. OPEN VOICE ↗

sections.heading: Inspect the contract, then integrate.

sections.heading: Lacuna in your terminal.
sections.text: CLI Lacuna in your terminal. The same context without opening the dashboard. This is a recording of a real run, not a mock up. LACUNA TERMINAL RECORDED RUN HYDRADB CLOUD $ lacuna status ●··· ··· ·· ·· · lacuna ·· ·· ······ profile cloud store HydraDB Cloud, database lacuna, collection backend counts not available on this store $ lacuna ask Bellwether beta_partner Q Bellwether beta_partner A Halverd This replaced 2 earlier values and nothing has superseded it. Cited from Data planning call, 2025-04-20, user "Correction on Bellwether: the beta partner is now Halverd." 1 query, 443.1ms $ lacuna e
